## Wave 1 Summary

This wave attacks the MAGNITUDE half of the §6.3 a(t)/effective-Friedmann residual — the dimensionful origin of the substrate scale M_KK. S111-CF-MKK-RG-INVARIANCE FAILed under the BARE-IMPORT reading (`Δ_rel=8.193 ≫ 5e-2`, `leg1_RGinv=False`, `leg2_noimport=False`): with M_KK frozen from the CODATA-routed M_Pl_reduced cutoff, the scale is not τ-RG-invariant and the dimensionless transmutation ratio `R(τ)=exp(−1/(λ_eff(τ)·N₀(τ)))` flows strongly with τ (range `[3.6e-11, 0.160]`) while the imported M_KK does not. That FAIL *converted* the long-standing M_KK-derivation standing gap into a tractable, pre-registrable S112 compute gate.

The keystone gate (**W1-1**) gives the SUBSTRATE-NATURAL reading its fair, pre-registered test: can a substrate-internal dimensionful anchor `Λ_anchor` — supplied WITHOUT CODATA and WITHOUT routing through M_Pl — fix M_KK such that the two-leg τ-RG-invariance test passes? Two candidate anchors are PINNED explicitly (no runtime freedom). **W1-2** (mack-cosmic-bridge) is the CONDITIONAL downstream consumer: the H0-residual band closes dimensionfully iff W1-1 PASSes, releasing the 93.875% held by `s111_cf3_h0_residual.npz`; else H0 relief stays capped at the 6.125% dimensionless channel.

The substrate-physics stakes are honestly pre-registered: M_KK is a SELF-REFERENTIAL scale (`M_KK = 1/R_K`; `R_KK = 1.0000 M_KK⁻¹`; the substrate measures every observable in M_KK units, so `Δ_BCS=0.4643`, `a_0=6440.0`, `a_2=2776.17` are all pure numbers). A FAIL of W1-1 is therefore NOT an agent failure — it is the structural theorem that a self-referential unit system cannot fix its own absolute GeV scale from within (the lattice-QCD scale-setting analog: dimensionless ratios are predicted, but exactly ONE external dimensionful anchor is irreducibly required). This is the strongest possible negative result and is the registered fallback per the dual-prior below.

# (7) substitution_chain — MANDATORY ([SIGN] trigger; the two-leg directional + magnitude claim)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "M_KK is τ-RG-invariant under a substrate-natural anchor iff the anchor's
            τ-flow cancels the transmutation factor's τ-flow; absent such an anchor,
            the magnitude leg is a permanent external-import boundary."

    Step 1 (Definitions, all cited to substrate-first canonicals):
      R(τ)        = exp(−1/(λ_eff(τ)·N₀(τ)))          [S110 CV2A transmutation kernel; substrate-internal, DIMENSIONLESS]
      λ_eff(τ)    = ||K_a(τ)||²_{C2} / C_const          [Kosmann V-matrix per coset, Baptista Paper17 eq4.1; λ_fold=0.03893476]
      N₀(τ)       = windowed van-Hove DOS per mode      [B2 band group velocity v=dE_B2/dτ; N₀_fold=14.02325023]
      Λ_anchor(τ) = the candidate dimensionful anchor    [A: Δ_BCS·M_KK ; B: sqrt(a_2^{zeta}/(48π²))·M_KK]
      M_KK_target = 7.42866004e16 GeV                    [canonical_constants.py M_KK_gravity, S42 spectral-zeta/Newton route]
      M_KK(τ)     := Λ_anchor(τ) · R(τ)                  [dimensional-transmutation closed form, S110 CV2A]

    Step 2 (Substitute candidate B — the substrate-internal M_Pl twin — into M_KK(τ_fold)):
      M_KK(τ_fold) = sqrt(a_2^{zeta}/(48π²)) · M_KK · R_fold
                   = sqrt(2776.165389/(48π²)) · M_KK · 0.16016848

    Step 3 (Simplify the dimensionless prefactor, one step per line):
      48π²                     = 473.7410
      a_2^{zeta}/(48π²)        = 2776.165389 / 473.7410 = 5.860499
      sqrt(5.860499)           = 2.420846
      2.420846 · 0.16016848    = 0.387785

    Step 4 (Canonical form — read the self-reference):
      M_KK(τ_fold) = 0.387785 · M_KK
      ⇒ the closed form maps M_KK → 0.387785·M_KK (a fixed point ONLY at M_KK=0).
      ⇒ candidate B does NOT reproduce M_KK (it under-shoots by factor 0.387785,
        i.e. Δ_rel = |0.387785 − 1| = 0.612 ≫ 5e-2 IF the prefactor M_KK is held at
        target; equivalently, no nonzero M_KK is self-consistent).
      ⇒ both substrate-internal anchors reduce to M_KK·(pure number): the substrate's
        spectral data (a_2, Δ_BCS) are DIMENSIONLESS in M_KK units, so they cannot
        bootstrap the absolute GeV scale. This is the SELF-REFERENTIAL no-go.

    Step 5 (Direction read-off — the two legs):
      leg1_RGinv: M_KK(τ)=Λ_anchor(τ)·R(τ). For candidate B, Λ_anchor(τ)∝M_KK·sqrt(a_2(τ))
                  and R(τ) flows; the product is τ-FLAT only if sqrt(a_2(τ)) ∝ 1/R(τ).
                  PRE-REGISTERED: this proportionality is NOT a substrate identity (a_2(τ)
                  is a smooth spectral sum, R(τ) is a van-Hove-fold-localized exponential
                  with range [3.6e-11, 0.16]) ⇒ leg1 EXPECTED False unless the compute
                  reveals an unanticipated cancellation. SIGN of the test: the substrate-
                  natural anchor must FLATTEN the τ-product that the bare anchor left
                  steep (S111 Δ_rel=8.193 → target <5e-2).
      leg2_noimport: candidates A and B use ONLY {Δ_BCS, a_2^{zeta}, M_KK-as-unit} — no
                  CODATA. BUT "M_KK-as-unit" means the anchor is expressed IN M_KK units,
                  so it carries no INDEPENDENT GeV scale ⇒ to produce a GeV number, an
                  external scale must re-enter ⇒ leg2 "passes" set-membership trivially
                  while the anchor supplies no absolute magnitude (the degeneracy).

    Conclusion: PASS requires a substrate-internal Λ_anchor whose τ-flow cancels R(τ)'s
      AND which carries an independent GeV scale. The substitution chain shows both
      pinned candidates reduce to M_KK·(pure number) — neither carries an independent GeV
      scale (self-reference). The gate's honest pre-registered EXPECTATION is FAIL =
      magnitude leg is a permanent external-import boundary (the lattice-QCD scale-setting
      no-go: dimensionless ratios predicted, ONE external dimensionful anchor irreducibly
      required). A PASS would require the compute to surface a substrate-natural anchor
      mechanism not captured by candidates A/B (e.g. an absolute-scale-carrying
      thermodynamic observable), which the gate leaves open and tests.

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  A substrate-natural dimensionful anchor (one of the pinned candidates, or a mechanism
  the compute surfaces) fixes M_KK τ-RG-invariantly (leg1_RGinv=True) under a no-import
  reading (leg2_noimport=True) with Δ_rel<5e-2. The §6.3 a(t)/effective-Friedmann
  MAGNITUDE leg CLOSES: M_KK is substrate-derived, not externally pinned. Unlocks W1-2
  (the H0 residual's held 93.875% becomes dimensionfully addressable). Registers a new
  structural result (substrate-derived absolute scale) — would be the keystone PASS.
FAIL_meaning: >
  No substrate-internal anchor closes the loop: every candidate reduces to M_KK·(pure
  number) (self-reference) OR fails the τ-flatness/target conjunction. The magnitude leg
  is a PERMANENT EXTERNAL-IMPORT BOUNDARY — the self-referential-unit-system no-go
  (lattice-QCD scale-setting analog: dimensionless ratios predicted, ONE external
  dimensionful anchor irreducibly required). This is a STRUCTURAL THEOREM, not an agent
  failure (per math-scripts.md §"All Results Are Good Results"). Registers as the
  permanent boundary; §6.3 narrates M_KK-magnitude as an irreducible external pin
  (capstone-hygiene Q1 routing); H0 relief stays capped at the 6.125% dimensionless
  channel (W1-2 returns the capped reading). Reallocates 0.95 to dual-prior Track-B.
INFO_meaning: >
  Partial: exactly one leg passes, or a near-miss Δ_rel ∈ [5e-2, 5e-1]. E.g. leg1
  τ-flatness cancellation IS found for an anchor but it carries no independent GeV scale
  (leg2-degenerate); OR an anchor carries a scale but is not τ-flat. Corridor narrowed;
  residual (which leg, by how much) quantified; priors unchanged. Routes the precise
  residual to a next-session refinement CF if the near-miss is structural.

  excitations. The substrate measures EVERY observable in M_KK units: the D_K eigenvalues,
  the BCS gap Δ_BCS=0.4643, the Seeley-DeWitt moments a_0=6440.0, a_2=2776.17 are all
  PURE NUMBERS in M_KK units. The dimensional-transmutation factor R(τ)=exp(−1/(λ_eff·N₀))
  IS substrate-internal: λ_eff is the Kosmann coset-coupling read off D_K's Jensen
  deformation, N₀ is the van-Hove DOS pile-up at the fold τ=0.190 — the substrate's own
  BCS pairing kernel. The flow is FROM the D_K spectrum (λ_eff, N₀) → the transmutation
  ratio R → the scale M_KK. The keystone question is whether the substrate can supply the
  ONE dimensionful anchor R must multiply, WITHOUT borrowing CODATA. The honest answer the
  framework's self-referential structure predicts: a unit system that measures everything
  in M_KK cannot fix M_KK's absolute GeV value from within — the same structural reason
  lattice QCD must input one dimensionful quantity (proton mass / f_π) to set its scale
  while predicting all dimensionless ratios. A FAIL is therefore the substrate telling us
  exactly where its predictive reach ends and where one external anchor is irreducibly
  required — the strongest possible negative result, and the §6.3 magnitude-leg boundary.

## Wave 1 → Wave 2 Decision Point

Wave 2 (the four Stage-2 cross-axis verifies: CLOCKLOC3, NOHOLOFLUX, M1-INTERTWINER, VIICJ) does NOT consume Wave 1 outputs — the Stage-2 verifies are independent of the M_KK keystone. Wave 1 therefore imposes NO prerequisite on Wave 2; the two waves are parallel-dispatchable.

Internal to Wave 1 (the only branching this wave drives):

- **W1-1 PASS** → dispatch W1-2 with the PASS outcome; W1-2 attempts the dimensionful draw (PASS/FAIL on band-closure). Route the new substrate-derived-M_KK result to a capstone §6.3 update (Q1-YES per capstone-hygiene-gate.md: the a(t)/effective-Friedmann magnitude-leg status changes). Promote the substrate-natural anchor mechanism via the canonical write-order (verdict → canonical_constants → falsifier-master-inventory).
- **W1-1 FAIL** → dispatch W1-2; W1-2 returns the capped 6.125% reading (band_closed=False, the registered fallback). Route to capstone §6.3 as a PERMANENT external-import boundary (Q1-YES + Q3-YES: PROVEN→ the magnitude leg is irreducibly external; narrate with the self-referential-unit-system no-go, scope-qualified per the S100a "irreducibly external, not a refinable approximation" precedent). Register the no-go as a structural result; mack-cosmic-bridge logs the 6.125% H0-relief ceiling.
- **W1-1 INFO** → dispatch W1-2; W1-2 returns INFO (band-closure deferred). Route the precise residual (which leg failed, by how much) to a next-session refinement CF.
- **W1-1 UNCOMPUTED at W1-2 dispatch** → W1-2 mechanical closure per `.claude/rules/mechanical-closure-discipline.md` (`value='PRE-REG-INC_blocked_by_CF-S112-MKK-SUBSTRATE-ANCHOR_UNCOMPUTED'`, FAIL, per-gate-distinct audit_sha256, working-paper §W1-2 updated in the same closure run). Carry W1-2 to S113.

## Wave 1 Substrate-First Provenance Note

Both gates source every numerical pin from substrate-first computation, not external-paper placeholders:

- **R(τ), λ_eff, N₀** — substrate-internal (S110 CV2A / S111 MKK-RG bit-exact); the Kosmann coset-coupling and van-Hove DOS are read off the D_K Jensen deformation.

- **Δ_BCS=0.4642547** — substrate canonical (R-protected, S70 BCS-GAP-CANONICAL-70).
- **M_KK_target=7.42866004e16 GeV** — the canonical M_KK_gravity (S42 CONST-FREEZE-42). NOTE: this is the SUBSTRATE'S CURRENT external pin — W1-1's whole purpose is to test whether it can be substrate-DERIVED rather than imported. The gate explicitly audits (leg2) whether the candidate anchors avoid re-importing it or M_Pl.
- **M_Pl_reduced=2.435e18** (CODATA 2018) — appears ONLY in the `codata_exclusion_set` as the thing leg2 audits for ABSENCE. It is NOT a PASS-contributing input; it is the BARE-IMPORT scale the substrate-natural anchor must replace.

No SCHEMATIC helper is consumed (no `_spectral_action_regulators.py`); both gates use the substrate-first cached scalars + closed-form arithmetic. No `CLASS: SCHEMATIC` pin required.
